selected: Original muted-palette generation; transparent compositing QA confirmed alpha is clean. Cleanup variants were not selected.
cleanupPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached three-stage tree sprite strip. Remove ALL the blurry colored background, glow and halos completely to alpha=0. Keep only solid tree leaves, branches, trunk, roots, stump and wood chips. Preserve original painted tree art, species, exact notch and stump appearance. Do not retain any colored haze between branches or outside the silhouette. Actual clean transparent background, no checkerboard painted in. Reposition/scale all three stages uniformly as needed so each fits wholly in its own equal-width column with at least 20 pixels fully transparent margin; left intact, middle notched, right stump. 1536x1024 canvas, three512px columns; same scale for all stages, ground anchors x256,768,1280 y920. No text or lines.

prompts.oak:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite strip for Safety Last, a painterly three-quarter top-down woodland survival game.
Create ONE 1536 by 1024 transparent PNG sprite strip, exactly THREE equal 512 by 1024 cells across, no borders, no text. Broad woodland oak: generous irregular rounded crown of layered olive and moss-green leaves, thick warm brown bark, stout spreading roots.
Left cell: intact tree. Middle cell: exactly the same tree still upright, same crown/branches and roots, now partly chopped with a large clearly visible triangular axe notch in the lower front-right trunk exposing pale fresh wood, a few small wood chips beside its base. Right cell: the same tree fully felled, ONLY its short rooted stump remains, irregular fresh cut top with growth rings and a few splinters; all upper trunk, branches and canopy absent.
Camera: elevated 3/4 game camera looking down about 50 degrees, orthographic, NOT a flat side elevation, consistent across cells. Render hand-painted high-quality dimensional game artwork, finely textured bark, rounded readable forms, natural rich muted woodland colours, warm upper-left highlights, softly shaded right sides, matching polished painted survival-game props. No black outlines, no photoreal background.
CRITICAL REGISTRATION: each tree occupies at most 440px of its own cell width. Trunk centre is at x=256 within EACH cell. Ground/root anchor is exactly y=900 in all three cells; ALL upper blank space above the stump stays transparent. Roots and stump diameter match the intact trunk, never enlarge the stump to fill its cell. Each complete sprite stays inside its cell with generous transparent margins; nothing cut off. Intact and partly chopped crowns are visually identical in shape, scale, pose and position. Every stage uses the same camera, lighting and scale. Minimal soft contact shadow directly under roots only, no long directional shadow, no terrain, no dirt island, no axes, no people, no labels, no grid. Real alpha transparency.
